subject.title: RFC: Remote Agent Harness Bridge and Event Protocol

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this as the upstream remote-harness v1 contract now, and if so which protocol frames, compatibility migration, and package ownership are in the accepted scope?
rationale: The PR intentionally proposes a new portable contract rather than repairing an established repository behavior; the unresolved contract and migration choices cannot be settled mechanically from the RFC alone.

options.title: Keep draft; resolve scope in maintainer discussion
options.body: Use the required maintainer-discussion thread to settle the v1 frame boundary, transport naming, migration path, and owning package before accepting the RFC.

options.title: Accept a narrower baseline
options.body: Limit acceptance to the current bridge baseline and move richer event preservation or model-egress behavior into a follow-up RFC.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Leave the draft open without acceptance until an upstream owner and implementation sequence are available.

recommendation.title: Keep draft; resolve scope in maintainer discussion
recommendation.body: Use the required maintainer-discussion thread to settle the v1 frame boundary, transport naming, migration path, and owning package before accepting the RFC.

likelyOwner.reason: Their related proposal and implementation-informed review provide the clearest available routing signal for the remote-harness contract discussion.
